notes.title: Update 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changes


 The process of replenishing stamina will now use orange crystals instead of green crystals.
 (This is to make it easier to place more towers and make it more difficult to increase the range of towers)


 Trolls now drop 500 crystals instead of 250 green crystals when they are killed.


 The starting amount of green crystals has increased from 500 to 1000.


 The health of Poison, Fire and Ice towers has been increased from 100 to 150.


Additions


 Biome Balance: It is possible to make the game easier by placing more than one biome in a single direction. A biome balance system has been added to prevent this.

notes.title: Update 0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
CHANGES

Crystal Transformation

 50 red crystals are now required to transform into 50 green crystals instead of 100 red crystals.


 50 red crystals are now required to transform into 50 orange crystals instead of 100 red crystals.


Tower Costs

 The Poison Tower, Fire Tower, and Ice Tower now cost 100 green crystals instead of 125 green crystals.


 The Void Tower now costs 200 green crystals instead of 250 green crystals.


Tower Range Upgrade Value

 The range of all towers is now increased by 0.50 instead of 0.20 when upgraded.


ADDITIONS

Crystal Totems

 A single type of totem has been added for now.


 Totems appear every 5th hour of the day, and if they are not destroyed, the enemies become stronger.
